step1_analysis.circuit_type: Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) and Current Mirrors
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is an unbuffered OTA (XM1-XM3, XM9) driving multiple PMOS current sources (XM4, XM6, XM7, XM10). It is likely the core of a Bandgap Reference (BGR) or a constant-gm bias generator, where the OTA forces the voltages at its inputs (N6, N5) to be equal. The resulting output (N3) biases the PMOS current mirrors to distribute proportional currents to various isolated branches, which aligns with the paper's mention of isolation circuits.

paper_reference.title: Secure Contactless Smartcard ASIC with DPA Protection

dc_gain.description: Open-loop DC gain of the OTA

paper_reported.technology: Not specified (likely 0.35um or 0.5um based on 2001 and 3V supply)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * (ro_n || ro_p). With L=0.5um, lambda is around 0.05-0.1 V^-1. Intrinsic gain per transistor is ~20-40 V/V. Total gain is roughly 40-50 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 66 dB, which might have used longer channels or cascoded structures. With SKY130 L=0.5um, a single-stage uncascoded OTA typically achieves 40-50 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm / (2 * pi * C_load). Without an explicit load capacitor in the netlist, C_load is just parasitic (~50fF). gm ~ 1mS. UGBW ~ 1mS / (2*pi*50fF) = 3 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 3.39 MHz reported in the paper likely includes a large compensation or load capacitor. In this isolated testbench without external load caps, the bandwidth will be extremely high (parasitic limited).

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the location of the non-dominant pole at the current mirror node (N7).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard stability requirement for an OTA in feedback.

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_total. At 1.8V, assuming ~100uA per branch, total current is ~500uA. Power = 1.8V * 500uA = 0.9 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply compared to the paper's 3V supply. The OTA core consumes a fraction of the total chip power.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure OTA open-loop gain, bandwidth, phase margin, and power consumption. The loop is closed at DC using a large inductor to establish a stable operating point, and opened at AC using a large capacitor to inject the test signal.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Secure Contactless Smartcard ASIC OTA Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N7 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N7 N6 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N9 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 N5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Power supply and Ground
VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
VGND GND 0 DC 0
VN2 N2 0 DC 0

* Biases for auxiliary PMOS current sources
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 DC 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.9

* Dummy loads to keep auxiliary current sources in saturation
V_N1 N1 0 DC 0.9
V_N4 N4 0 DC 0.9
V_N9 N9 0 DC 0.9
V_N0 N0 0 DC 0.9

* OTA Biasing and AC input
* N6 is the Non-Inverting input (+)
V_N6 N6 0 DC 0.8 PULSE(0.75 0.85 1n 1n 1n 1u 2u)

* N5 is the Inverting input (-)
* Close the loop for DC to stabilize the high-gain node (N3), open for AC
L1 N3 N5 1G
C1 N5_ac N5 1G
V_N5_ac N5_ac 0 DC 0 AC 1

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
* DC Operating Point and Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N3) v(N7) v(N6) v(N5)

* AC Analysis for Gain and Phase Margin
ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N3)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N3))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Step Response
tran 1n 3u
meas tran v_max max v(N3)
meas tran v_min min v(N3)

quit
.endc
